title: Understanding the organisation and its context
summary: Determine internal and external issues relevant to the AI management system, including the organisation's AI roles (provider, producer, customer or user) and whether climate change is relevant (Amd 1:2024).
typical_evidence: Context analysis naming the organisation's AI roles and AI systems in scope; climate change consideration

title: Needs and expectations of interested parties
summary: Identify interested parties relevant to the AI management system and which of their requirements (legal, contractual, ethical) it will address.
typical_evidence: Interested parties register with AI-related requirements and obligations

title: Scope of the AI management system
summary: Define and document the boundaries of the AI management system, including which AI systems, roles and activities it covers.
typical_evidence: AIMS scope statement listing AI systems, roles and exclusions

title: AI management system
summary: Establish, implement, maintain and continually improve the AI management system and its processes.
typical_evidence: AIMS manual or process map; evidence the processes operate

title: Leadership and commitment
summary: Top management shows leadership by setting the AI policy and objectives, integrating the AIMS into business processes, providing resources and promoting improvement.
typical_evidence: Management meeting minutes; resourcing decisions; communications from leadership

title: AI policy
summary: Top management sets an AI policy suited to the organisation's purpose that frames AI objectives and commits to meeting requirements and to continual improvement; it is documented and communicated.
typical_evidence: Approved AI policy with version history and communication record

title: Roles, responsibilities and authorities
summary: Assign and communicate responsibility and authority for the AI management system and for reporting on its performance.
typical_evidence: RACI or role descriptions for AIMS owners; appointment records

title: Actions to address risks and opportunities: general
summary: Plan actions for risks and opportunities affecting the AIMS, distinguishing intended use from reasonably foreseeable misuse of AI systems.
typical_evidence: Risk and opportunity register for the AIMS; planned actions

title: AI risk assessment
summary: Define and apply an AI risk assessment process with criteria that identifies, analyses and evaluates risks of AI systems, including potential consequences for the organisation, individuals and society.
typical_evidence: AI risk assessment methodology and criteria; completed AI risk assessments

title: AI risk treatment
summary: Select treatment options and controls, compare them with Annex A, and produce a statement of applicability with justifications, plus a risk treatment plan approved by risk owners.
typical_evidence: Statement of applicability for Annex A; AI risk treatment plan with owner approvals

title: AI system impact assessment
summary: Define a process to assess potential consequences of AI systems for individuals, groups and society across their life cycle, and use the results in risk assessment.
typical_evidence: AI system impact assessment procedure; completed impact assessments

title: AI objectives and planning to achieve them
summary: Set measurable AI objectives at relevant functions and levels, and plan what will be done, by whom, with what resources and by when.
typical_evidence: AI objectives with measures, owners and target dates; progress tracking

title: Planning of changes
summary: Carry out changes to the AI management system in a planned manner.
typical_evidence: AIMS change records

title: Resources
summary: Determine and provide the resources needed for the AI management system.
typical_evidence: Budget and staffing decisions for the AIMS

title: Competence
summary: Determine required competence for people affecting AI performance, ensure it through education, training or experience, and keep evidence.
typical_evidence: Competence matrix for AI roles; training and qualification records

title: Awareness
summary: People working under the organisation's control are aware of the AI policy, their contribution, and the implications of not conforming.
typical_evidence: AI policy acknowledgements; awareness training completion

title: Communication
summary: Determine internal and external communications relevant to the AIMS: what, when, with whom and how.
typical_evidence: Communication plan for the AIMS; samples of communications

title: Documented information
summary: Maintain the documented information the standard and the AIMS require, and control its creation, update, access, retention and disposal.
typical_evidence: Document register; document control procedure; version history

title: Operational planning and control
summary: Plan, implement and control the processes needed to meet AIMS requirements and Annex A controls, including externally provided processes.
typical_evidence: Operating procedures for AI systems; supplier controls for outsourced AI processes

title: AI risk assessment (operation)
summary: Perform AI risk assessments at planned intervals and when significant changes are proposed or occur, and keep the results.
typical_evidence: Dated AI risk assessments for the period, including change-triggered ones

title: AI risk treatment (operation)
summary: Implement the AI risk treatment plan and verify its effectiveness; keep the results.
typical_evidence: Treatment plan status; evidence controls were implemented

title: AI system impact assessment (operation)
summary: Perform AI system impact assessments at planned intervals and when significant changes occur, and keep the results.
typical_evidence: Dated impact assessments for in-scope AI systems

title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
summary: Decide what to monitor and measure for the AIMS, with methods and timing, and evaluate performance and effectiveness.
typical_evidence: AIMS metrics and their results; evaluation records

title: Internal audit
summary: Conduct internal audits of the AIMS at planned intervals with an audit programme and objective, impartial auditors.
typical_evidence: Internal audit programme; AIMS internal audit report; auditor independence

title: Management review
summary: Top management reviews the AIMS at planned intervals with the required inputs and records decisions on improvement and changes.
typical_evidence: Management review minutes covering required inputs and decisions

title: Continual improvement
summary: Continually improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the AI management system.
typical_evidence: Improvement log; actions from reviews and audits

title: Nonconformity and corrective action
summary: React to nonconformities, find root causes, take corrective action, check effectiveness, and keep records.
typical_evidence: Nonconformity and corrective action log with root cause analysis

title: AI policy
summary: Document a policy for the development or use of AI systems.
typical_evidence: AI policy document

title: Alignment with other organisational policies
summary: Determine where other policies (security, privacy, quality, safety) are affected by or apply to AI objectives.
typical_evidence: Policy alignment analysis; cross-references between AI and other policies

title: Review of the AI policy
summary: Review the AI policy at planned intervals or when needed to keep it suitable and effective.
typical_evidence: Dated AI policy review records

title: AI roles and responsibilities
summary: Define and allocate roles and responsibilities for AI according to the organisation's needs.
typical_evidence: AI roles and responsibilities matrix

title: Reporting of concerns
summary: Provide a process for people to report concerns about the organisation's role with respect to an AI system across its life cycle.
typical_evidence: Concern-reporting channel and procedure; log of concerns and responses

title: Resource documentation
summary: Identify and document the resources each AI system needs across its life cycle.
typical_evidence: Per-system resource inventory

title: Data resources
summary: Document information about the data resources used for AI systems.
typical_evidence: Dataset inventory with sources, purpose and owners

title: Tooling resources
summary: Document information about the tools used for AI systems (frameworks, libraries, platforms).
typical_evidence: Tooling inventory for AI development and operation

title: System and computing resources
summary: Document information about the system and computing resources used for AI systems.
typical_evidence: Infrastructure inventory for model training and serving

title: Human resources
summary: Document the human resources and competences used for AI systems across the life cycle.
typical_evidence: AI team roster with competences

title: AI system impact assessment process
summary: Establish a process to assess potential consequences for individuals, groups and society of developing, providing or using AI systems.
typical_evidence: Impact assessment procedure
category: A.5 Assessing impacts of AI systems

title: Documentation of AI system impact assessments
summary: Document and retain impact assessment results for a defined period.
typical_evidence: Filed impact assessments with retention rule
category: A.5 Assessing impacts of AI systems

title: Assessing AI system impact on individuals or groups
summary: Assess and document potential impacts of AI systems on individuals or groups throughout the life cycle.
typical_evidence: Impact assessments covering fairness, privacy and safety for affected people
category: A.5 Assessing impacts of AI systems

title: Assessing societal impacts of AI systems
summary: Assess and document potential societal impacts of AI systems throughout the life cycle.
typical_evidence: Impact assessments covering societal effects
category: A.5 Assessing impacts of AI systems

title: Objectives for responsible development of AI systems
summary: Identify and document objectives that guide responsible development and integrate them into the development life cycle.
typical_evidence: Responsible AI development objectives; evidence they appear in requirements or reviews

title: Processes for responsible AI system design and development
summary: Define and document processes for responsible design and development of AI systems.
typical_evidence: AI SDLC procedure; design review records

title: AI system requirements and specification
summary: Specify and document requirements for new AI systems or material enhancements.
typical_evidence: Requirements documents for AI systems

title: Documentation of AI system design and development
summary: Document the AI system design and development based on objectives, requirements and criteria.
typical_evidence: Design documents; model cards; architecture decisions

title: AI system verification and validation
summary: Define and document verification and validation measures and the criteria for their use.
typical_evidence: Test and evaluation plans; validation results against acceptance criteria

title: AI system deployment
summary: Document a deployment plan and make sure requirements are met before deployment.
typical_evidence: Deployment plans; release approvals for AI systems

title: AI system operation and monitoring
summary: Define and document what is needed for ongoing operation, including monitoring, repairs, updates and support.
typical_evidence: Model monitoring dashboards and alerts; operations runbooks

title: AI system technical documentation
summary: Determine and provide technical documentation needed by each relevant category of interested party.
typical_evidence: Technical documentation sets per audience

title: AI system recording of event logs
summary: Determine at which life cycle phases event logging is enabled, at minimum while the AI system is in use.
typical_evidence: Logging configuration for AI systems; sample inference and decision logs

title: Data for development and enhancement of AI systems
summary: Define, document and implement data management processes for developing AI systems.
typical_evidence: Data management procedure for AI training and evaluation data

title: Acquisition of data
summary: Determine and document how data used in AI systems is acquired and selected.
typical_evidence: Data acquisition records; licences and consents for datasets

title: Quality of data for AI systems
summary: Define and document data quality requirements and make sure data used meets them.
typical_evidence: Data quality criteria and check results

title: Data provenance
summary: Define and document a process to record the provenance of data used in AI systems over their life cycle.
typical_evidence: Data lineage or provenance records

title: Data preparation
summary: Define and document criteria for selecting data preparations and the preparation methods used.
typical_evidence: Data preparation procedures; preprocessing records

title: System documentation and information for users
summary: Determine and provide the information users of the AI system need.
typical_evidence: User-facing documentation, notices and instructions for AI features

title: External reporting
summary: Provide a way for interested parties to report adverse impacts of the AI system.
typical_evidence: External reporting channel; log of reports and responses

title: Communication of incidents
summary: Determine and document a plan for communicating AI system incidents to users and other parties.
typical_evidence: AI incident communication plan; past incident notices

title: Information for interested parties
summary: Determine and document obligations to report information about the AI system to interested parties, such as regulators.
typical_evidence: Register of reporting obligations; records of submissions

title: Processes for responsible use of AI systems
summary: Define and document processes for the responsible use of AI systems.
typical_evidence: Acceptable use procedure for AI systems and tools

title: Objectives for responsible use of AI systems
summary: Identify and document objectives that guide responsible use of AI systems.
typical_evidence: Responsible use objectives

title: Intended use of the AI system
summary: Make sure AI systems are used according to their intended use and accompanying documentation.
typical_evidence: Intended-use statements; monitoring of use against them

title: Allocating responsibilities
summary: Allocate responsibilities across the AI life cycle between the organisation, its partners, suppliers, customers and third parties.
typical_evidence: Contracts or RACI allocating AI responsibilities

title: Suppliers
summary: Make sure services, products or materials from suppliers align with the organisation's approach to responsible AI.
typical_evidence: AI supplier assessments; contract clauses

title: Customers
summary: Make sure the approach to responsible development and use of AI considers customer expectations and needs.
typical_evidence: Customer AI commitments; terms; customer-facing AI documentation
